You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository iterative/dvc.

Problem Statement:
`dvc remote add` replaces the existing remote silently
The `dvc remote add` command ignores the existing remote and overwrites it silently.
```
→ dvc --version
0.32.1+7d7ed4
```

### To reproduce

```bash
dvc remote add s3 s3://bucket/subdir
dvc remote add s3 s3://bucket/subdir2
```

### Expected behavior

The second command `dvc remote add s3 s3://bucket/subdir2` should fail with the `Remote with name "s3" already exists` message.

### Current behavior

Remote URL is silently overwriten:
```bash
> cat .dvc/config
['remote "s3"']
url = s3://bucket/subdir2
```

entries.content: Behavior verified: duplicate add fails with the expected error and keeps the original URL; `-f` overwrites. Existing tests pass.

entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Root cause: `CmdRemoteAdd.run` wrote the remote section unconditionally via `_set`, silently overwriting an existing remote of the same name. Fix: in `dvc/command/remote.py`, `remote add` now checks whether the remote section already exists in the target config and fails with `remote with name "<name>" already exists. Use -f|--force to overwrite it.` (exit code 1), and a new `-f/--force` flag on the `remote add` parser allows intentional overwriting.
